audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Marked crossing-curve length is not invariant on the pants-twist quotient.; Completed standard grt1 cannot be identified with or injected into the printed all-genus direct sums.; The displayed free-Lie lower bound does not imply the printed endpoint normalization.
limitations: Counterevidence: Pants curves and twist-invariant classes descend. Pants twists permute the set C of all node-crossing curves, so the collective condition ell_gamma>M for every gamma in C does descend. The already-invoked collar lemma supplies uniform local control near a node.
Counterevidence: Surrounding genus-graded language plausibly intends the direct-sum graded subalgebra. Every fixed-genus assertion is unaffected.
Counterevidence: Actual handlebody homology may contain extra classes. The cited CGP statements require any base strictly smaller than beta; nonvanishing and exponential growth remain supported.
Counterevidence: Actual Corollary3.7 is in2g-2+n+m>0, excluding this example.
Limitations: The stronger endpoint inequality for actual handlebody Betti numbers remains unproved or undisproved here.
Limitations: The entire Giansiracusa, Ji-Wolpert and sheaf-theoretic spectral-sequence proofs were not reconstructed; the original coverage limitations remain.
Limitations: Teichmuller-metric normalization, the boundary-to-cusp locus comparison and the ordinary-cohomology formulation remain bounded unresolved points, not extra confirmed defects.

Limitations: No author code was executed. Historical matrix/Witt calculations remain attributed to their original performers; the current check independently re-derived the mathematical coefficient argument.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Marked crossing-curve length is not invariant on the pants-twist quotient.

Completed standard grt1 cannot be identified with or injected into the printed all-genus direct sums.

The displayed free-Lie lower bound does not imply the printed endpoint normalization.

Unqualified boundary-twist sequence fails at low complexity.
